semantics: Six pre-existing snapshots only; no exact per-request or 200ms barrier identity join.
First scrape occurs several seconds after first grant; terminal scrape occurs after coordinator terminal, not an exact measured interval.
Histogram mean is delta sum/count only for same initialized monotone series; buckets are boundaries, not exact quantiles.
Slot apply duration measures time since proposal future creation, not isolated FSM execution.
slot scheduler process_slot is execution wall time after dequeue, not direct scheduler queue wait.
DB message_commit runtime wait histogram is caller-visible commit request duration, not isolated queue waiting.
Pebble metrics are periodically refreshed gauges initialized to zero; zero alone does not prove physical storage latency absence.
No raw metrics lines, dynamic identities, channels, or config values are retained.
